file other.env MATRIX_AI_BASE=$BOT/elsewhere\nMATRIX_AI_TOKEN=good\nMATRIX_AI_MXID=@ai_nova_ab12cd:example.org\n
run identity login --token-file $WORK/other.env
error usage
